description: This Java source file defines the REST API resource for managing charges on savings accounts within the Apache Fineract platform. It includes endpoints to list, retrieve, create, update, pay, waive, inactivate, and delete savings account charges, utilizing JAX-RS annotations for HTTP method mappings, and integrates with various services for security, serialization, command processing, and domain data retrieval.

classes.name: SavingsAccountChargesApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for handling savings account charges, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, paying, waiving, inactivating, and deleting charges.

methods.name: retrieveAllSavingsAccountCharges
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all savings charges, optionally filtered by charge status.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for creating savings charges with default and applicable values.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific savings account charge.

methods.name: addSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Creates a new savings account charge based on the provided JSON request body.

methods.name: updateSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Updates an existing savings account charge.

methods.name: payOrWaiveSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Performs actions such as paying, waiving, or inactivating a savings account charge based on the command parameter.

methods.name: deleteSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Deletes a savings account charge if allowed.
